name: setup-manaflow-ai-kerf-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, after the fast native editors: theme files for color, the terminal palette and proportions (Kerf, dark, the default; Kerf Light), settings for the agent panel's sans at a reading size and a threads sidebar grouped by project with branch and age on every row, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens that boxes your prompt in a hairline and keeps tool calls as one-line rows, and a customize view for a compact, list-like hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Kerf sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Kerf's hover card and sidebar rows: a compact list-like card (title and age, then branch, change and task lines in the muted gray), rows in regular weight with a thin arc while a thread works.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/kerf-light.json:
// Kerf Light: the same fast editor in the One family's light: a near-white editor, light gray
// panels, the lightest-gray title and tab bars, one-pixel borders, an indigo-blue accent and the
// One Light palette in the terminal, deepened where a color would not read on white.

  "name": "Kerf Light",
  "description": "A fast editor, light: One Light grays, one-pixel chrome, a dense project panel, an indigo-blue accent.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  // background: the editor (#fafafa). foreground: the One Light text (#242529). selection: the accent
  // at 24% over the editor. accent: the One Light blue (#5c78e2).
  "colors": { "background": "#fafafa", "foreground": "#242529", "selection": "#d3daf5", "accent": "#5c78e2" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "ghostty": [
    "background = #fafafa",
    "foreground = #242529",
    "cursor-color = #5c78e2",
    "cursor-text = #fafafa",
    "selection-background = #d3daf5",
    "selection-foreground = #242529",
    "palette = 0=#242529",
    "palette = 1=#c4473c",
    "palette = 2=#437a38",
    "palette = 3=#8f6c00",
    "palette = 4=#4561cf",
    "palette = 5=#9a42a8",
    "palette = 6=#2f74a8",
    "palette = 7=#58585a",
    "palette = 8=#747579",
    "palette = 9=#b8392f",
    "palette = 10=#3f7a35",
    "palette = 11=#7f5f00",

  // The terminal face: SF Mono at 13 pt, the system's own monospaced face, as a native editor uses.
  "terminal.fontFamily": "SF Mono",
  "terminal.fontSize": 13,

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "appearance.fontSmoothing": "antialiased",

  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",
  "appearance.borders": "default",

  "appearance.titleAreaContrast": 1,
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "tabs",
